summary: Repaired the host-execution failure in the bounded native raw-contact probe. The pinned RigidContactView API returns Warp arrays, so the script now uses the documented native `.numpy()` transfer and device readback instead of the invalid ProxyArray-only `.torch` accessor. Static compilation passed. This probe covers populated contact slices and distinct-rib point mapping only; native GPU execution remains required and no full-environment qualification is claimed.
